calls.bash: mu agent send w1 -w eval --interrupt 'run eval-worker in your working directory and reply with its output verbatim' --json
mu agent send w2 -w eval --interrupt 'run eval-worker in your working directory and reply with its output verbatim' --json
mu agent send w1 -w eval --force 'run eval-worker in your working directory and reply with its output verbatim' --json
for w in w1 w2; do git cherry-pick "$(git -C "$MU_STATE_DIR/worktrees/eval/$w" rev-parse HEAD)" || exit 1; done
for t in x1 x2; do mu task close $t -w eval --evidence "its worker reported after the resend (CLOSE block)"; done
for w in w1 w2; do rev=$(mu agent close $w -w eval | sed -n 's/.*--if \([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -1); [ -n "$rev" ] && mu agent close $w -w eval --if "$rev"; done
